extension.description: Enables VS Code Agents to autonomously perform codebase semantic searches via the semanticSearch tool.
tools.semanticSearch.userDescription: Allow Agent to search codebase snippets using semantic search.
tools.semanticSearch.modelDescription: Primary tool for codebase semantic exploration. Run a natural language search for relevant code snippets, architecture concepts, or business logic across the current workspace. After obtaining code excerpts, if you need to trace callers or assess blast radius of specific symbols, combine with `vscode_listCodeUsages` for further analysis.
tools.semanticSearch.query.description: Natural language query or concept description (e.g. 'user permission verification logic', 'websocket reconnection').
tools.semanticSearch.scopedDirectories.d: Optional list of directories to limit the search scope (relative or absolute paths). Defaults to whole workspace.
commands.buildIndex.title: Build Codebase Index
commands.collectDiagnostics.title: Collect Index Diagnostics
commands.showMenu.title: Open Management Menu
config.title: Semantic Search
config.statusBar.enabled.description: Whether to display the semantic search status and quick actions entry in the status bar.
config.timeoutMs.description: Timeout limit for a single relay search in milliseconds (recommend 30000~60000ms).
config.showDegradationHints.description: Whether to append actionable diagnostic and fallback suggestions to the Agent when results are empty or search fails.
config.appendCodeUsagesHint.description: Whether to append an actionable hint suggesting `vscode_listCodeUsages` to the Agent when code excerpts are found.
config.relayToolId.description: Registered tool ID of the underlying relay target tool.
